About.sectionTitle: For twelve years I've played every wedding as if it were my own.
About.sectionDescriptionFirst: My name is Marek Nowicki and for twelve years I've hosted some of the most beautiful weddings in Poland. I don't just play a playlist — I read the room, sense the moment and build energy so that every guest, from grandma to the youngest, finds their way onto the dance floor.
About.sectionDescriptionSecond: Class, stage presence and top-tier equipment are a given. The rest is instinct — which is exactly why couples recommend me to their friends.

Offer.sectionTitle: Three packages. One goal - your perfect evening.
Offer.sectionDescription: Weddings, proms, birthdays, corporate events — every celebration. Each package is tailored to your venue and guest count. Write to me for a made-to-measure quote.
